'''Reik Sopil''' was the brother of [[Owal Sopil]], a minor [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], one of the most feared criminal organizations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When his brother was caught skimming cargo during his runs and taken to a remote bunker complex on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to await judgment by the local [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]], Reik approached his friends, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], to help mount a rescue. Calrissian owed Sopil a favor and Sopil was able to cover Rendar's fee for the mission. The group arrived on Endor shortly after the local Vigo and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] assistant, the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]], traveled to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to deal with Owal; and other matters.
